# Astra public resource keys

<!-- Generated by tools/Report-AstraResourceKeys.ps1. Do not edit by hand: a hand edit is a claim
     the pipeline does not produce. Re-run the tool and commit both. -->

Every row the layer publishes, in load order. `alias` is the `ResourceKey` a `StaticResource` row
points at - the alias layer only re-names a palette object, so overriding the alias moves every
control that reads it and nothing else. Literal rows carry their value. A style row carries its
`TargetType`; rows with no key are implicit styles and are listed by type only, because the
lookup is by type and an application cannot name them.

Scope caveat: a keyed element written *inside* a template is listed as well, because it is a row in
the same file, but its lookup scope is that template - one `LinearGradientBrush` in
Styles/Common.jalxaml is the only such row today, and the count is the only place it shows up.

Totals: 1245 keyed or implicit rows in 57 dictionaries (368 palette, 744 token, 133 style), 101 high-contrast mapping rows.
